# OSPFv3 (`ospfv3`)

- **Layer**: L3 (network)
- **Header**: 16 octets (fixed)
- **Notes**: [Routing protocols](../../protocols/routing.md)

## Reached from

| Lower layer | Selector | Value |
|---|---|---|
| [`ipv6`](ipv6.md) | `next_header` | 89 (0x59) |
| [`ipv6_hopopts`](ipv6_hopopts.md) | `next_header` | 89 (0x59) |
| [`ipv6_route`](ipv6_route.md) | `next_header` | 89 (0x59) |
| [`ipv6_frag`](ipv6_frag.md) | `next_header` | 89 (0x59) |
| [`ipv6_dstopts`](ipv6_dstopts.md) | `next_header` | 89 (0x59) |

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Auto | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | `uint(8)` | `3` |   | OSPF version (2 = OSPFv2, 3 = OSPFv3). |
| `type` | `enum(8)` | `1` (hello) | Protocol number of the next layer (see Next layer) | OSPF packet type (Hello / DB Description / LS Request / LS Update / LS Ack; Auto from the next layer). |
| `packet_length` | `uint(16)` |   | Length of the header and payload in octets | Length of the OSPF packet including the header, in octets (Auto). |
| `router_id` | `ipv4` | `192.0.2.1` |   | Router ID of the sending router. |
| `area_id` | `ipv4` | `0.0.0.0` |   | Area the packet belongs to (0.0.0.0 = backbone). |
| `checksum` | `uint(16)` |   | Internet checksum with pseudo header over the header and everything after it | Internet checksum over the OSPFv3 packet with the IPv6 pseudo header (Auto). |
| `instance_id` | `uint(8)` | `0` |   | Instance ID (separates OSPFv3 instances on one link). |
| `reserved` | `uint(8)` | `0` |   |   |

### `type`

| Value | Name |
|---|---|
| 1 (0x01) | `hello` |
| 2 (0x02) | `db_description` |
| 3 (0x03) | `ls_request` |
| 4 (0x04) | `ls_update` |
| 5 (0x05) | `ls_ack` |

## Next layer

The next layer is selected by `type`; when the field is Auto the builder writes the value of the protocol stacked above.

| Value | Protocol | Note |
|---|---|---|
| 1 (0x01) | [`ospfv3_hello`](ospfv3_hello.md) |   |
| 2 (0x02) | [`ospfv3_dbd`](ospfv3_dbd.md) |   |
| 3 (0x03) | [`ospfv3_lsr`](ospfv3_lsr.md) |   |
| 4 (0x04) | [`ospfv3_lsu`](ospfv3_lsu.md) |   |
| 5 (0x05) | [`ospfv3_lsack`](ospfv3_lsack.md) |   |
